high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @theidolfacts. The post features a close-up photograph of a 20 Rupee Indian currency note. The note prominently displays the Ellora Caves, a famous archaeological site located in Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India. Image Content: The main focus is on the 20 Rupee note, which is partially visible with the top portion showing the denomination "TWENTY RUPEES" and the symbol ₹20.
